# Iran Market Data

Public, no-auth JSON files for current and historical Iranian market prices.

- Website and documentation: https://iran-market.github.io/
- All latest prices in toman: https://iran-market.github.io/data/latest-toman.json
- Curated popular prices: https://iran-market.github.io/data/popular.json
- Complete canonical symbol guide: https://iran-market.github.io/data/symbols.json
- Complete published-history directory: https://iran-market.github.io/data/history/index.json
- USD/IRR daily OHLC history: https://iran-market.github.io/data/history/USD_IRR_FREE.json
- Gold 18K/IRR daily OHLC history: https://iran-market.github.io/data/history/GOLD_18K_IRR.json
- Emami coin/IRR daily OHLC history: https://iran-market.github.io/data/history/COIN_EMAMI_IRR.json
- USDT/IRR daily OHLC history: https://iran-market.github.io/data/history/USDT_IRR.json
- Manifest and update metadata: https://iran-market.github.io/data/manifest.json

Current-price files update every 30 minutes. Daily-history files update once per day. Current upstream source: TGJU. Prices are informational.
